JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A private AI-assisted journal session record owned by a specific user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

summary.description: AI-generated summary and reflections from the conversation.

insights.description: List of key takeaways, action items, or brainstorm bullet points.

tags.description: Category or topic tags associated with the session.

mood.description: User's state of mind or session theme.

messageCount.description: Number of turns in the conversation.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Basic profile for an authenticated user.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document isolated per user UID.

/users/{userId}/journals/{journalId}.description: Private journal entries isolated under the authenticated user's UID.
